title: 有馬記念の後に・福、来たれり

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the distant roar of the crowd pushing her forward, Matikanefukukitaru dominates the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Matikanefukukitaru who relied purely on luck is no more. Almost fainting with elation over her new accomplishment, she heads to the winner's interview…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Where she tells the spectators that happiness comes to those who seek it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She follows that with a grand announcement that she will continue to run for her fans, promising to bring them happiness.
